Scraped r/StableDiffusion 1wclxbj 'H3 RefMods are great' (Choowkee, 2026-09-10, 153up/89 comments) -> docs/h3-refmods-thread.md; index + skill references/refmods.md updated. KEY: always <Subject N> for refmods (never <Picture N>/<Background N>/<Pose N>), subjects defined in REFMOD LOADER ORDER, attributes repeated in retention_analysis and re-stated in parentheses at each use in detailed_description (the no-bleed recipe); static shots need 'static shot' in BOTH summary and detailed_description. Measured speed win over plain image refs is only ~7% (one user 10-20s on 9 images) - the real wins are baked latents and freeing <Picture> slots. BACKGROUND BLEED is the failure mode: the refmod's own background leaks and the prompt can't override it; fix = strength AND retention both 1 + supply the environment as FIRST IMAGE with a <Picture 1> line (implies FNI refmods must never be baked from frames whose background we're replacing; background_retention=0 alone may not suffice). VOICE in refmods NOT proven (community: timbre matching 'not quite there yet', visual+audio refmods can't be tagged) - our earlier ~1:1-from-long-sample claim is unverified. Size discipline: 5-8MB refmods slow generation vs ~1MB. Refmods ignore extra_model_paths.yaml. FranckyB/ComfyUI-H3RefMods fork adds audio+video refmods and a visual refmod picker. GAP IDENTIFIED (Alex asked why the Shaitan refs weren't put in a refmod): no tool in tools/ bridges refs/characters/<NAME>/ to a baked .refmod - we only ever documented the recipe. Blocker: Shaitan crops are unapproved and only 2-3 usable frames exist (a refmod wants 6-9+).

Thread payoff is the OP's own months-later follow-up: 'I use Z image Turbo with the omni controlnet - I draw the image badly, write a prompt, and let the model figure out how to draw it properly'; model = alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union (single 3.10GB union file, canny/depth/hed/pose). Other routes in-thread: Qwen Image Edit 2509 converts squiggles but 'make the drawing better' does nothing (add dx8152/Qwen-Edit-2509-Multiple-angles + lovis93/next-scene-qwen-image-lora-2509); a multi-pane prompt trick on Z-Image Turbo with no controlnet. 4090 SETUP VERIFIED: ComfyUI at C:/Users/gsfny/venvcomfyui/ComfyUI v0.39.0; extra_model_paths.yaml -> E:/comfymodels (is_default:true); core already has ZImageFunControlnet in comfy_extras/nodes_model_patch.py (aliases 'z-image controlnet'/'controlnet union'), consumed as a MODEL_PATCH from ModelPatchLoader => the file goes in E:/comfymodels/models/model_patches/ NOT models/controlnet/ (controlnet dir is empty anyway). Z-Image Turbo bases already in E:/comfymodels/models/diffusion_models/zit/ (z_image_turbo_bf16, zImageTurboAIO, zimageTurboByStable...). comfyui_controlnet_aux installed. This is the missing mechanism for the v3.1 master plates - sketch the setup, prompt the environment, get a composition-controlled plate, without touching the 5090. Storyboard pipeline built (4090). (1) Downloaded Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union.safetensors 3,101,572,408 bytes to E:/comfymodels/models/model_patches/ (HF size matches; header parses, 136 control_* tensors). Folder confirmed by ComfyUI's own blueprint 'ControlNet (Z-Image-Turbo).json' which names the file + directory 'model_patches'. (2) Wrote tools/plate_sketch.py - builds the API graph UNETLoader(zit/z_image_turbo_bf16) + CLIPLoader(Qwen3-4B-abliterated, type lumina2) + VAELoader(ae) + ModelPatchLoader(union) -> ZImageFunControlnet -> ModelSamplingAuraFlow(shift 3) -> KSampler(res_multistep/simple, 8 steps, cfg 1) -> VAEDecode -> SaveImage; latent size follows the sketch via GetImageSize; negative is ConditioningZeroOut. Supports --dry-run, uploads the sketch to /upload/image, queues /prompt, waits on /history. Dry-run validated: 14 nodes, plates/graphs/TEST_room.json; test sketch plates/sketches/TEST_room_sketch.png. No extra VAE/encoder download needed: ae.safetensors IS the Z-Image VAE and the box's Qwen3-4B == official qwen_3_4b. Remaining: ComfyUI not running on the 4090 (8188 refused) and LM Studio holds ~3.9GB of 24GB. (3) Second thread 1o81vyt digested into docs/h3-storyboard.md: the Next Scene LoRA is NOT worth it (goddess_peeler's same-seed A/B showed 'hardly any difference', OP says 'not stable enough', plus black borders) but the TECHNIQUE is - image -> local LLM prompt 'come up with a story and include the shot information, separate prompts by carriage return, no less than 10 story shots' -> a chain of 'Next Scene: camera move + reveal' lines generated in sequence. That is a shot-chain drafter (LM Studio on the 4090); it complements, not replaces, our ledger motion[]/shot_type[]/angle[].

Shaitan refs: Alex supplied two abduction frames (C:/Users/gsfny/Downloads/shot_00216_f00000.jpg, shot_00217_f00013.jpg) - both the black panther in full snarl/roar, the best identity refs found. 00216: chest-up, mouth open showing fangs + pink interior, long white whiskers, bright yellow eyes, only creature in frame, carved dark-wood structure with TWO glowing blue gem insets behind. 00217: whole animal roaring, yellow-green slit pupils, claws extended on the front paw, standing on a magenta/deep-purple cushion, carved furniture with FOUR blue gem insets in a square, human legs (purple tights) intrude top edge. Same Fire Keep set as S05, identifiable by the carved furniture + blue gem insets = a repeating set element for the plate. Added to refs/characters/SHAITAN/candidates/ (untouched jpgs + crops incl. a face crop with the legs removed); note.txt updated with an addendum. TEST 1 (first real test of the technicolor direction) - NEGATIVE, and the mechanism is MEASURED. tools/render_one.py queues one chunk bypassing the render ledger (the batch renderer skips already-rendered chunks, which made A/B impossible). Ran S05-c01 (Fire Keep study, 12.25s/294 frames, 20 steps) with the new technicolor style string + h3/models/retro-fantasy-step00003750.safetensors @0.8, same seed as the existing take: 322s, output renders/5090/video/S05-c01_technicolor_t01_00001_.mp4 (864x480, 294 frames, 24fps, aac 32kHz stereo). VERDICT: the look did NOT change - frames at t=2s and t=9s both still classify as 2D cel animation with muted/flat colour. PROOF: the generated t=0 frame differs from the source still shot_00188_f00000.jpg (the graph's first_frame) by mean-abs-pixel 5.6/255 = 2.2%, and mean saturation only 0.613 -> 0.650. So FL2VA pins the exact 1983 animation frame as the start and never escapes it. CONSEQUENCE: FL2VA (and Track C / FFLF, and any Track B wired to source stills) is structurally incapable of changing the medium register; a prompt + style LoRA cannot override two pinned animation frames. Confirms Consequence 2 in docs/plans/direction-80s-sword-and-sandals.md by measurement instead of argument, for 322s of GPU time instead of a day of character sheets. FIX: restyle the endpoints first (Z-Image Turbo + Fun ControlNet union) then FL2VA from the restyled frames - needs the 4090 (that is where the union controlnet + plate tooling live); the 5090 CANNOT do it (its ModelPatchLoader list is empty, no union controlnet, and no Qwen-Image-Edit base model). 4090 blocked while LM Studio holds 22.2/24.5GB. Control queued: same chunk/seed with --strip-lora to see whether the LoRA does anything at all. Also added an optional style-LoRA hook to pipeline/fullrun.py (env FNI_STYLE_LORA / FNI_STYLE_LORA_STRENGTH, node 147 LoraLoaderModelOnly) - off by default.

Gemini design thread (share.gemini.google/G3igMCsRQ6aC, 2026-10-13): Alex's stated final direction is a technicolor 80s sword-and-sandals remake (Ben-Hur x Beastmaster, unlimited FX budget) via Civitai minimax-h3-forgotten-worlds-retro-fantasy. Still-generation pivots to Krea 2 (open-weights, ComfyUI; Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder = natural-language prompts 80-150w, 8-step Euler/Simple CFG 1.0; LoRAs: krea2_Storyteller_LoRA ~0.3-0.5, Krea2_Enhancer) stacked with Alex's existing character LoRAs. Thread also explored the contrasting Path 1 = Barry Lyndon/Duellists locked-off painterly style with Frazetta canvases as literal locations (Track C boundary-lock engine) vs Path 2 = Blade Runner/Legend-era set-piece spectacle (Track B engine). 3-track matrix unchanged: A rotoscope (REF2VA 6-field + Bakshi video ref), B restage (FL2VA 3-field, plate+stills+audio), C boundary lock (FL2VA + FFLF). Unresolved question at thread end: feed original Frazetta canvases into Krea 2 as image refs vs generate from Civitai LoRAs. Gemini drift warnings: it invented names like stage7_assemble.py / refs/setups plates / 'v3.1 architecture' — verify against repo before adopting.

Alex clarifying the Gemini thread: 'the barry lyndon side is more like the analogy of the direction. using the paintings as the set pieces.' — i.e. NOT a locked-off Kubrick camera regime. The paintings (Frazetta originals or AI renders of them) ARE the sets/locations: master setup plates = painted canvases, and the film is shot 'on location' inside them. Technicolor 80s Ben-Hur x Beastmaster direction stands; the Barry Lyndon/Duellists comparison only means paintings-as-setpieces, not naturalistic lighting or static camera.
